about: The models Philibert offers. Add one here and push: every drive's dropdown lists it after its next Update, and downloads it the first time someone picks it. 'tag' is what `ollama pull` takes - a name from ollama.com/library, or hf.co/<user>/<repo>:<quant> for a GGUF on Hugging Face. 'min_gpu_gb' is the GPU memory it needs to run at full speed; 'auto' lets first-run setup choose it for a machine with that much.

models.good_for: Short answers on older or low-power computers. It has to think longer than the 8B to get things right, so answers come slower.
models.label: Qwen3.5 4B
models.note: Fast on any computer, even without a graphics card.

models.good_for: Questions, writing, summaries, notes and simple coding - right and quick on most computers. The one to start with.
models.label: Qwen3 8B
models.note: The everyday tier for a 6-8 GB graphics card.

models.good_for: Longer writing, trickier questions and more careful answers. Wants a graphics card with 12 GB or more.
models.label: Qwen3 14B
models.note: Sharper answers; wants a 12-16 GB graphics card.

models.good_for: Hard reasoning, long documents, planning and coding. Needs a 16 GB graphics card and loads slowly from a drive.
models.label: Qwen3.8 27B
models.note: The strongest, for a 16 GB card. Slow to start from a USB drive; never picked automatically.

models.good_for: Like the big careful thinker, but it will discuss subjects that cautious models turn down. Needs a 16 GB graphics card.
models.label: Qwen3.8 27B Defiance
models.note: Another 27B build (Defiance, by ttindall); a little stronger on our tests, a little slower.

models.good_for: The most exact copy of the big thinker, for when quality matters more than speed. It is too big for most graphics cards, so it runs partly on the processor and is slow.
models.label: Qwen3.8 27B Defiance Q6
models.note: Highest quality 27B; needs a very large graphics card or a lot of patience - best for long jobs left running.

models.label: Llama-3.2-3B - Cracked
models.good_for: Quick short answers on any computer, and it answers what cautious models turn down. Too small for hard questions, maths or long documents.
models.note: Meta's Llama 3.2 3B with its refusals removed (bartowski build). Fast even without a graphics card.

models.label: gemma-3-4b - Cracked
models.good_for: Writing, rewording and friendly chat - good prose for its size, and no refusals. Text only in this build; weak at maths and coding.
models.note: Google's Gemma 3 4B with refusals removed (abliterated v2, by mlabonne).

models.label: Llama-3-8B-Lexi - Cracked
models.good_for: Chat, stories and role-play with no refusals. An older model (2024): the Everyday helper beats it at facts, maths and coding.
models.note: Llama 3 8B fine-tuned by Orenguteng to follow any request; you are responsible for how you use it.

models.label: GPT - Coder
models.good_for: Code, scripts and step-by-step reasoning - OpenAI's open model, in the format it was made in. Fits a 16 GB graphics card whole. Keeps its original safety rules.
models.note: gpt-oss-20b in its native MXFP4 (ggml-org) - the best copy for a 16 GB card; the other quantizations are no smaller.

models.label: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B - Image-Cracked
models.plain_name: Big thinker that sees, no refusals
models.good_for: Looks at pictures and talks about them, and handles long answers and reasoning - with no refusals. It reads images; it does not make them (that is Image Generation).
models.note: Qwen3.5 35B 'mixture' model that wakes only 3B at a time, so it stays quick even partly on the processor (21 GB + 0.9 GB vision part; on a 16 GB card about a quarter runs on the CPU).

models.good_for: Looks at pictures and screenshots and says what is in them, word for word. Philibert needs it whenever you show it an image.
models.label: Qwen2.5-VL 7B (vision)
models.note: Reads pictures: posters, receipts, setlists, screenshots. Always installed.

models.good_for: Lets Philibert find the right notes in your vault by what they mean, not just by words. Small, and always kept.
models.label: nomic-embed-text
models.note: Lets Philibert search its own notes. Downloaded on first run.
